spec.rawSql:
SELECT datastore_data, percent_use 
FROM datastore_usage 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY percent_use DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT datastore_data, type, total_capacity, space_use, free_space, percent_use 
FROM datastore_usage 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY percent_use DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) as count 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND unity_metrics."sizeTotal" IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) as count 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) as count 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND entity = 'performance_metrics_by_node'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT appliance_id) as count 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND entity = 'performance_metrics_by_appliance'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_vm
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
        id,
        is_deleted
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '${dc1}'
    ORDER BY id, created_at DESC
) t
WHERE is_deleted = false;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS nb_vm
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
        id,
        is_deleted
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$dc2'
    ORDER BY id, created_at DESC
) t
WHERE is_deleted = false;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS created
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        MAX(created_at) AS first_seen,
        (ARRAY_AGG(is_deleted ORDER BY created_at DESC))[1] AS is_deleted
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$dc1'
    GROUP BY id
) t
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND first_seen >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS created
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        MAX(created_at) AS first_seen,
        (ARRAY_AGG(is_deleted ORDER BY created_at DESC))[1] AS is_deleted
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$dc2'
    GROUP BY id
) t
WHERE is_deleted = false
  AND first_seen >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS destroyed
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
        id,
        destroyed_at
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$dc1'
    ORDER BY id, created_at DESC
) t
WHERE destroyed_at >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS destroyed
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
        id,
        destroyed_at
    FROM vm_lifecycle
    WHERE datacenter = '$dc2'
    ORDER BY id, created_at DESC
) t
WHERE destroyed_at >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT datastore_data) as count 
FROM datastore_usage 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT SUM(total_capacity) * 1073741824 as total_bytes 
FROM datastore_usage 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT AVG(percent_use) as avg_percent 
FROM datastore_usage 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
